name: Surf²f Training and Rendering Pipeline
definition: A hybrid representation for surface reconstruction that learns an implicit Signed Distance Function (SDF) $f$ and an explicit surrogate surface mesh simultaneously, unified by a shared neural shader for both volume and surface rendering.
summary: Surf²f is a hybrid neural representation that simultaneously learns an implicit SDF and explicit mesh, unified by a shared neural shader to enable real-time interactive rendering with high geometric accuracy.
